name: banana_8d_strong
title: Strongly Twisted Banana Posterior (8D) from Haario et al. (1999)
description: The banana-shaped posterior distribution is a common test case for MCMC algorithms. It is created by twisting a Gaussian distribution with a non-linear transformation. This particular version is 8 dimensional and the curvature coefficient is set, according to the paper, to pose a challenge for MCMC algorithms.
